records.part: Locomotive Service Life Extension and Repair - overhaul of out-of-service and in-service MP36 locomotives
records.reason: In an effort to provide robust service for the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games and ensure a general state of good repair for the Authority's rolling stock fleet, the Authority intends to repair and overhaul four (4) out-of-service MP36 locomotives

records.part: 20-Ton Rail Jacks for ZEMU (portable jacks to support Stadler Zero Emission Multiple Unit)
records.reason: The Authority requires a set of 20-ton portable jacks to accommodate the new Stadler Zero Emission Multiple Unit (ZEMU)... The new ZEMU vehicle is heavier than the DMU and requires higher rated jacks for support.
